body:
Threw out my back and couldn't really walk so my friend brought me some Gabapentin his girlfriend gave him.  I took 900mg then my roommate offered me nitrous whippits. I took 4 and now I feel absolutely great and I can bend my back again. This is my first time on Gabapentin and it seems to work. I wont take again after reading so many horror stories though.
